pl-l2d34c1-d1e108.summary: Turns to actual sin, to be investigated diligently: the origin and cause of the first sin, whether a good or evil thing; in what thing sin is; what sin is and in how many ways it occurs; and the differences among sins.

pl-l2d34c1.summary: Turns to actual sin, setting out the questions: the origin and cause of the first sin, whether a good or an evil thing; in what thing sin exists; what sin is and in how many ways it occurs; and the differences among sins.
claims: The treatment of actual sin begins.
Questions: the origin of sin, its subject, its definition, its modes, and its kinds.
